visual_action: A montage of video clips showing Donald Trump on a golf course. He is seen driving a golf cart, walking on the green, putting (and missing shots), and preparing to swing. In some clips, he appears somewhat awkward or uncoordinated. Other people, including caddies and fellow golfers, are visible in the background.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is visually present in all clips, playing golf, and is named in the on-screen text 'trump golf lowlights'.

spoken_summary: The audio consists of the hip-hop song "Ima Boss" by Meek Mill ft. Rick Ross. The lyrics are about success, wealth, and toughness, with lines like "Look, I be riding through my old hood, but I'm in my new hood," "Same old attitude, but I'm on that new shit," and "Remember me damn broke. Look at me up now."
audio_music: The video features the upbeat, boastful hip-hop track 'Ima Boss' by Meek Mill ft. Rick Ross, which plays consistently throughout the entire montage. The confident and powerful tone of the song creates an ironic contrast with the visuals, which are framed as 'lowlights'.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various short clips of Trump golfing.
central_claim: The video compiles clips of Donald Trump golfing, presenting them as 'lowlights' to mock his athletic abilities and physical appearance.
intended_effect: To make the viewer laugh at and ridicule Donald Trump by portraying him as unathletic and clumsy.
